name: Exp_XAng_Zad_C_Tm_MMRec
summary: This EA trades based on an extended angular indicator with a lag/delay confirmation filter, time session restrictions, and a money management recovery position sizing system. It combines trend direction from angular price calculations with delayed signal confirmation and time-gated entries, while employing a recovery-based lot sizing algorithm after losses.
summary_zh: 该EA基于扩展角度指标与延迟确认过滤器进行交易，同时加入时段限制和资金管理恢复机制。它将角度价格计算的趋势方向与延迟信号确认及时间门控入场结合，并在亏损后采用恢复式仓位管理算法。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于扩展角度指标（XAng）判断趋势方向，角度指标通常衡量价格的斜率变化来判断趋势强度和方向。Zad（延迟/滞后）机制作为信号确认过滤器，避免在趋势初期不确定阶段入场，等待价格确认后再执行交易。C（确认）层添加了额外的确认条件，可能是另一个指标或价格行为确认，形成多重过滤体系。Tm（时间）模块限制交易时段，避免低流动性或高波动时段交易。MMRec（资金管理恢复）是最关键的仓位管理模块，它在亏损后增加仓位大小试图恢复之前的损失，这本质上是一种类似马丁格尔的递增仓位策略。出场条件可能基于角度指标的转向或固定止盈止损，但恢复式仓位管理在连续亏损时会显著增加风险敞口。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core relies on an extended angular indicator (XAng) to determine trend direction, where the angular indicator typically measures price slope changes to assess trend strength and direction. The Zad (delay/lag) mechanism serves as a signal confirmation filter, avoiding entries during the uncertain early phase of a trend and waiting for price confirmation before executing trades. The C (confirmation) layer adds an additional confirmation condition, possibly another indicator or price action confirmation, forming a multi-filter system. The Tm (time) module restricts trading sessions, avoiding low-liquidity or high-volatility periods. MMRec (Money Management Recovery) is the most critical position sizing module, which increases position size after losses to attempt recovery of previous losses—this is essentially a Martingale-like incremental position strategy. Exit conditions are likely based on angular indicator reversal or fixed take-profit/stop-loss, but the recovery-style position management significantly increases risk exposure during consecutive losing streaks.

parameters.name: MMRec_Mode
parameters.description: 资金管理恢复模式（0-固定手数，1-递增恢复）

parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, typically set at gap close

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 多重过滤系统（角度+延迟+确认）减少了虚假信号入场
时间过滤器避免在不利的交易时段开仓，降低滑点和点差风险
延迟确认机制有助于避免趋势初期的假突破
参数化设计允许用户根据不同品种和周期调整策略
恢复式资金管理在单次亏损后可以较快回本
pros_en: Multi-filter system (angular + delay + confirmation) reduces false signal entries
Time filter avoids opening positions during unfavorable trading sessions, reducing slippage and spread risk
Delay confirmation mechanism helps avoid false breakouts at early trend stages
Parameterized design allows users to adjust strategy for different instruments and timeframes
Recovery money management can recoup losses faster after a single loss event
cons: MMRec恢复式仓位管理本质上是马丁格尔变体，连续亏损时风险指数级增长
最大恢复次数限制虽然存在但仍可能导致巨大回撤
角度指标在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号
延迟确认虽然减少假信号但也意味着入场更晚，降低盈亏比
缺乏明确的整体风险控制机制如最大回撤限制或账户权益保护
cons_en: MMRec recovery position sizing is essentially a Martingale variant, with exponentially growing risk during consecutive losses
Maximum recovery step limit exists but can still lead to massive drawdowns
Angular indicators easily generate frequent false signals in ranging markets
Delay confirmation reduces false signals but also means later entries, worsening risk-reward ratio
Lack of explicit overall risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or account equity protection
improvements: 添加最大账户回撤保护，当回撤超过阈值时停止交易并重置仓位到基础手数
在震荡市识别（如ADX低于阈值）时暂停交易或减小仓位，避免角度指标频繁误判
improvements_en: Add maximum account drawdown protection that stops trading and resets position size to base lot when drawdown exceeds threshold
Pause trading or reduce position size during ranging market detection (e.g., ADX below threshold) to avoid frequent misjudgments by angular indicator

risk_points: MMRec恢复式仓位管理在连续亏损时呈指数级增加仓位，可能导致灾难性亏损
缺乏全局风险控制如最大回撤限制或账户权益百分比止损
角度指标在震荡行情中频繁发出错误信号叠加恢复式加仓可能快速消耗账户
risk_points_en: MMRec recovery position sizing increases positions exponentially during consecutive losses, potentially leading to catastrophic losses
Lack of global risk controls such as maximum drawdown limit or account equity percentage stop-loss
Angular indicator frequently generates wrong signals in ranging markets, compounded by recovery position increases that can rapidly deplete the account

summary_en: This EA trades based on an extended angular indicator with a lag/delay confirmation filter, time session restrictions, and a money management recovery position sizing system. It combines trend direction from angular price calculations with delayed signal confirmation and time-gated entries, while employing a recovery-based lot sizing algorithm after losses.
